cc:Work.dc:title: Prediction-packet coverage on DEV
cc:Work.dc:description: Valid prospective prediction packets V divided by all eligible executed actions D in four exposed public DEV games (seed 101): B1 331/422 (78.4%), A1 276/374 (73.8%), and P 89/417 (21.3%). The dashed line marks the frozen per-arm feasibility gate, V/D >= 50%. B0 is excluded by design. These are packet-availability ratios, not prediction accuracy, a DEV score or efficacy. Actions are not IID; no confidence intervals, significance or causal advantage are asserted. A1 uses the documented JSON-format adjudication; P counts come from the sole pure coverage diagnostic and do not clear the original refusal.
